Create a new transmission control block (TCB) to hold connection state information. Fill in local socket identifier, remote socket, Diffserv field, security/compartment, and user timeout information. Verify the security and Diffserv value requested are allowed for this user.
Create a new transmission control block (TCB). Select an initial send sequence number (ISS). Issue a SYN segment of the form <SEQ=ISS><CTL=SYN>. Set SND.UNA to ISS, SND.NXT to ISS+1.
Change the connection from passive to active. Select an ISS. Send a SYN segment. Set SND.UNA to ISS, SND.NXT to ISS+1.

transitions.event: SEND Call with remote socket specified
transitions.action: Change connection from passive to active, select an ISS. Send a SYN segment, set SND.UNA to ISS, SND.NXT to ISS+1. Data associated with SEND may be sent with SYN segment or queued for transmission after entering ESTABLISHED state. The urgent bit if requested in the command must be sent with the data segments sent as a result of this command.
